td_stack.note: 3 real scorers (each 39%+ to find the end zone on our numbers), one per game so they're independent, each at the best price across betrivers/fanatics; built for the highest chance to cash among +EV scorers, not the biggest number. Pays ~17:1; cashes 8% of the time on our numbers (fair +1194), +39% expected return per dollar IF the edges are real. Why no stars: last season's 1-TD-a-game backs score in ~51% of the next season's games (measured), and the market prices them at 64-76% — so the +EV touchdowns live at plus money, and three of them pay 15-30:1. A real-edge lotto-lite, sized small, not a lock.
